purpose: Separates relationship-CLASS vocabulary (governed schema concepts) from relationship-INSTANCE truth (requires evidence). Instances use typed subject -> predicate -> object semantics so the data encodes the actual direction of the proposition.
rules: A relationship class is a controlled schema concept and may exist without asserting any instance; class existence does NOT depend on a source.
A relationship INSTANCE requires >=1 evidence reference and is NOT created in this sprint.

Instances are directed propositions: subject --predicate--> object. The representation MUST encode the real direction (e.g. GEO-MA --imports--> molybdenum_disulfide = 'Morocco imports [the substance]', never the reverse).
Inverse views (e.g. 'imported_by') are DERIVED, never stored as a second authoritative fact.
Endpoint types are controlled; each class declares allowed subject_types and object_types.
Language is orthogonal to geography; a lexeme's language never implies a geography endpoint.

notes: subject_type must be in the class's allowed subject_types; object_type in its allowed object_types.
evidence_ids MUST be non-empty for qualification_state == 'evidence_qualified'.
No inverse instance is stored; inverse is derived.

proposed_source_categories.note: Schema-integrity PROPOSAL only. NOT added to source_registry.json; no sources invented. Ratified by a later Source Qualification sprint.

evidence_strength_rule: For importer/exporter/producer/industrial_user instances, >=1 PRIMARY authoritative source is required to reach evidence_qualified; secondary_contextual sources add context but never establish the instance alone.

relationship_classes.label: is_supply_chain_node_for
relationship_classes.proposition: subject (place/organization) is a supply-chain node for object (substance/concept)

relationship_classes.label: has_terminology_context_in
relationship_classes.proposition: subject (lexeme) has an evidence-qualified terminology-usage context in object (geography). NOTE: this is separate from the lexeme's LANGUAGE; a German-language lexeme does not imply a Germany context — that requires its own evidence.

relationship_classes.label: regulates
relationship_classes.proposition: subject (jurisdiction) regulates object (substance/concept) via a governed instrument
